news.title: Arab League Warns of Repercussions of Continued Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia
news.og_title: Arab League Warns of Repercussions of Continued Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia
news.og_desc:
Cairo, November 12, 2026, SPA -- The Arab League strongly condemned continued attacks by the Houthi militia on Saudi Arabia, involving the launch of ballistic and cruise missiles and UAVs toward areas including Makkah, Riyadh, Eastern and the southern regions.
    The attacks mark a dangerous escalation and reflect the militia’s persistence in threatening Saudi Arabia’s security and stability and endangering civilian lives, the league said in a statement on Thursday.
    The league stressed that targeting Saudi territory, including areas housing Islam’s holy sites, constitutes a flagrant violation of the Kingdom’s sovereignty and territorial integrity and a clear breach of international law and the UN Charter. It also undermines the sanctity of holy sites and provokes Muslims around the world.
    The league praised the efficiency and vigilance of Saudi air defenses in intercepting and thwarting the attacks, helping protect civilians and safeguard the Kingdom’s security. It reaffirmed its full solidarity with and support for Saudi Arabia in confronting any threats to its security, sovereignty, and stability. The league also voiced support for the legitimate measures Saudi Arabia takes, in accordance with international law, to protect its territory, citizens, and residents.
    The league warned that continued attacks would heighten tensions, undermine efforts to contain the escalation, and threaten the region’s security and stability. It called on the international community, particularly the United Nations Security Council, to fulfill its responsibilities in addressing the repeated attacks and ensuring the full implementation of relevant Security Council resolutions, foremost among them resolutions 2216 (2015) and 2817 (2026), to put an end to practices that threaten the security of Arab states and regional and international peace and security.
    -- SPA
